name: Computational Chemistry
tagline: Simulating reality with quantum mechanics, molecular dynamics, and AI predictions.
seo_title: Computational Chemistry — paper summaries, news & innovations | Chemisters
seo_description: Follow Chemisters Computational Chemistry on LinkedIn and Facebook: paper summaries, news and innovations in quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, docking and machine-learned potentials.

definition.lead: Computational chemistry uses computers to calculate the structures, energies and behaviour of molecules and materials.
definition.body: From quantum calculations on a single molecule to simulations of millions of atoms, it lets chemists test ideas before going to the lab, explain experiments and screen thousands of candidates for drugs, catalysts and materials.

timeline.title: The Roothaan equations
timeline.text: Molecular orbital theory is recast as matrix equations.

timeline.title: Monte Carlo simulation
timeline.text: Metropolis and colleagues introduce a random-sampling algorithm for many-particle systems.
timeline.why: Still among the most used algorithms in science.

timeline.title: The first molecular dynamics
timeline.text: Berni Alder and Thomas Wainwright simulate colliding hard spheres.
timeline.why: Following particles step by step on a computer.

timeline.title: Simulating a real liquid
timeline.text: Aneesur Rahman simulates liquid argon with realistic forces.

timeline.title: Gaussian
timeline.why: Quantum chemistry became accessible to non-specialists.

timeline.title: QM/MM
timeline.text: Arieh Warshel and Michael Levitt combine quantum and classical models to study an enzyme reaction.

timeline.title: Proteins in motion
timeline.text: McCammon, Gelin and Karplus publish the first molecular dynamics of a protein.
timeline.why: Proteins seen as flexible, moving machines.

timeline.title: B3LYP
timeline.text: Axel Becke's hybrid functional appears, soon combined into the popular B3LYP.
timeline.why: One of the most cited methods in chemistry.

timeline.title: Neural network potentials
timeline.text: The ANI-1 potential is trained on millions of DFT calculations.

timeline.title: AlphaFold 2
timeline.text: DeepMind's AlphaFold 2 reaches near-experimental accuracy at the CASP14 assessment.

1 second

There is not enough experimental data
The equation is known to be wrong for molecules
Atoms are too heavy for quantum mechanics
quiz.explain: Exact solutions exist only for one-electron systems such as H₂⁺.
